final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), total AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts), ratios AS (SELECT c.birth_country, c.player_count, CAST(c.player_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM country_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count FROM ratios), selected AS (SELECT r.player_count, r.share, r.player_count - h.avg_count AS excess FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN threshold AS h WHERE h.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND r.player_count > h.avg_count) SELECT SUM(player_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM selected
